name: deck-craft
description: Self-contained slide-deck skill spanning three output targets from one body of deck craft: self-contained fixed-stage HTML presentations, lecturn.deck/1 JSON (and .pptx through the deckconv round-trip), and Diolog investor decks assembled from the 140-template / 12-recipe slide library. Carries its own visual-design layer rather than depending on a general design skill: consuming a supplied DESIGN.md or token file as binding context, authoring a direction when no brand exists (scheme / formality / density, subject-mined palettes, the signature element, the swap test), typography sized for projection with tracking and measure rules, colour strategy and accent budgets, five-vector hierarchy and cross-slide rhythm, anti-slop rules, and an accessibility floor calibrated for projection. Deck-specific narrative discipline: the title sequence as the deck's argument, speaking-vs-reading density, one idea per slide, deliver-the-whole-count, and the linear-flow usability rules (per-slide trunk test, recognition over recall, the honesty gate on charts and claims). Ships a per-slide build gate and a delivery review built on the verification epistemics that rendering an image is not seeing one, that the question you bring to a capture determines what you see in it, and that a clean gate means no known defect rather than verified. Direction evidence is read progressively from the template libraries on the machine (frontend-slides bold pack, open-design deck templates, portable design systems) without bulk-reading them. v1.1 folds the slide-template library into the skill: 200 layouts across 27 families (the established 140 verbatim plus 60 additions from an ADHD divergent-ideation gap analysis covering decision/ask, provenance, uncertainty, orientation, objection, flow, product/engineering, customer/commercial and people/plan — the three structural holes being that no template in the original 140 renders an ask, that the library is listed-company-shaped, and that nothing carries provenance or uncertainty as structure), 21 recipes (12 investor plus 9 business/product/engineering spines), the full slot contract and every validator rule including three deck-level floors that previously existed only in validate-deck.mjs (a headline figure authored as text at >=40px must be a stat, four or more slides on one ground fails, fewer than four distinct font sizes fails), a 34-system visual direction index with its progressive read rule, and layout-specs.md — a per-template block for all 200 giving zones fitted to the 1280x720 frame, the focal point and the hierarchy vectors that earn it, type roles, accent placement, the UX job, the failure mode, and measured caps that override the catalogue's authored-from-intent max values.
